metadata.summary: Hospital-scale chest X-ray database comprising 108,948 frontal-view X-ray images from 32,717 unique patients, with weakly-supervised multi-label disease annotations (8 initially, later expanded to 14) text-mined from radiological reports using NLP.
metadata.purpose: Supporting weakly-supervised classification and localization of common thoracic diseases using deep learning.

papers.title: ChestX-ray8 / NIH ChestX-ray14 — Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases

ethics.privacy_measures: Images de-identified prior to release; no protected health information (PHI) included.

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。
pending_verification: geography.countries 由局限文本启发式推断，待人工核实

known_limitations: Weakly-supervised labels lack spatial precision (no bounding boxes or segmentation masks).
Single-center origin limits generalizability across institutions, devices, and populations.
No demographic metadata (age, sex, ethnicity) reported; subgroup performance cannot be assessed.
Label noise due to NLP extraction from unstructured radiology reports.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — labels generated computationally via NLP; original DICOM images may have been converted to PNG.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ from single U.S. federal hospital (NIHCC); no evidence of multi-institutional or international representation.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Performance may degrade on images from different manufacturers, protocols, or patient demographics due to single-center, non-diverse origin.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage data reported (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity, geography beyond NIHCC).
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Demographic and clinical covariate data (e.g., age, sex, comorbidities) are not provided.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Pixel-level segmentation or precise lesion localization (due to absence of bounding boxes or masks).

data_origin.selection_rationale: X-ray images and associated radiological reports accumulated in NIH Clinical Center's PACS.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing frontal-view chest X-ray at NIH Clinical Center.
population.missing_groups: Demographic subgroups (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity, geographic origin beyond NIHCC) are not reported; representativeness beyond the single U.S. federal hospital is unknown.

attribute_recording.recoding_modifications: Disease labels text-mined from radiology reports via NLP; labels are weak (image-level, no bounding boxes or pixel-level ground truth).

annotation.annotation_method: Natural language processing (NLP) applied to radiological reports to extract 8 (later 14) disease labels per image.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels derived from radiology reports via NLP; no manual expert verification reported.
annotation.label_noise_description: Weak supervision: labels are image-level, multi-label, and subject to NLP extraction errors; no spatial localization ground truth provided.
